The api died at 03:14:06 on 2026-03-09 because the disk at `/var/lib/stockroom` filled up, and it never came back: the proxy was still logging "upstream api refused connection" at 05:28, and the log ends at 05:29:57.

The cause was the `report-export` job. It started at 03:05:00 and wrote 40 CSV parts of 512 MB each (about 20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` in under eight minutes. The disk hit 91% at 03:09:03 and 99% at 03:13:30. At 03:14:00 the database failed with "could not extend file ... No space left on device", the api aborted its transaction and shut down its worker pool, then exited with status 1.

The recurring `cache: slow command` warnings (100–150 ms, roughly every five minutes) run all night, from well before the incident, and look unrelated. Web and proxy requests kept returning 200 throughout.

To recover, free space by moving or deleting the `part-013xx.csv` to `part-014xx.csv` files in the exports directory, then restart the api; nothing in the log restarted it automatically. To stop it happening again, point the export at a volume that does not hold the database, or have the job check free space before writing.

The log does not show what triggered the export, and nothing in this repo defines the `report-export` job, so its schedule and settings live somewhere else.
